title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
hints: Brute force: for every start index extend to the right until a character repeats, tracking the best length with a set. That is O(n^2). Which work is repeated between neighbouring starts?
Keep a window [left, right] that always holds distinct characters. Extending right by one can invalidate the window only through the new character s[right].
Store the last index where each character was seen. When s[right] was last seen at p >= left, jump left to p + 1. Never move left backwards (try 'abba' by hand).
